summaries.title: Confidence Is All You Need: Few-Shot RL Fine-Tuning of Language Models
summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**训练与强化学习**（Training & RL）赛道，属于实证与机理剖析。针对当前领域面临的「高质量标注数据稀缺与规模成本瓶颈」痛点，作者围绕 **Confidence Is All You Need** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖大语言模型（Large Language Model (LLM)），并引入 Reinforcement Learning via Self-Confidence (RLSC) 等关键机制。核心论点主张：We propose Reinforcement Learning via Self-Confidence (RLSC), which uses the model's own confidence as reward signals-eliminating the need for labels, preference models, or...。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用强化学习策略优化与奖励驱动对齐。评测基准/数据集涵盖 **AIME2024**；实验规模与算力/平台配置涉及 **7B**。实验设计与验证细节：We propose Reinforcement Learning via Self-Confidence (RLSC), which uses the model's own confidence as reward signals-eliminating the need for...。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：关键量化指标达到 **+13.4%, +21.2%, +21.7%, +20.8%, +9.7%**；核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（Applied to Qwen2.5-Math-7B with only 16 samples per question and 10 or 20 training steps, RLSC improves accuracy by +13.4% on AIME2024, +21.2% on MATH500, +21.7% on Minerva Math,...）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为社区高关注度代表作（HF 133 赞），本工作修正了对 **训练与强化学习** 的经验性直觉假设，为后续算法改进指明了真正起作用的因果关键点；提供了清晰的算法/评测设计范式参考。

summaries.title: A Call for Collaborative Intelligence: Why Human-Agent Systems Should Precede AI Autonomy
summaries.perspective:
本研究聚焦于**智能体与代码工程**（Agents & SWE）赛道，属于实证与机理剖析。针对当前领域面临的「现有方法在复杂场景下的性能与效率权衡」痛点，作者围绕 **A Call for Collaborative Intelligence** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖大语言模型（Large Language Model (LLM)），并引入 LLM-based
Human-Agent Systems (LLM-HAS) 等关键机制。核心论点主张：This paper argues that progress in AI should not be measured by how independent systems become, but by how well they can work with humans。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用针对性模型架构设计与多维受控实验验证。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测。实验设计与验证细节：We suggest a different approach: LLM-based Human-Agent Systems (LLM-HAS), where AI works with humans rather than replacing them。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（The most promising future for AI is not in systems that take over human roles, but in those that enhance human capabilities through meaningful partnership）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为细分方向的扎实推进（HF 0 赞），本工作修正了对 **智能体与代码工程** 的经验性直觉假设，为后续算法改进指明了真正起作用的因果关键点；提供了清晰的算法/评测设计范式参考。
